profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, traded under the ticker CDNS, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The same site material also points to company culture, a listing among Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name specific products or AI offerings, so there is no product-level detail to report here. What it does establish is the company's stated position in electronic design automation and intelligent system design, with hardware, software, and intellectual property as its three delivery areas.

On the held facts, no individual lawsuits are listed, and no MCP servers are recorded. The litigation exposure that is recorded sits in California, with a count of 237.
